query:
UPDATE provider_subscriptions SET
                credential = $2,
                revision = $3,
                expires_at = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => $4),
                refresh_after = GREATEST(clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => $4 - $5), to_timestamp($6)),
                problem = NULL,
                updated_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE provider = $1
